gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-kannada: Stencil-cut and sleek, Bevellier crowds its letters tight. Anek Kannada's tall, squared-off woodblock-style letters and terminals that stop far from the stem keep page after page of text moving steadily without tiring.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vai: Ribbon-cut and graceful, Bevellier draws every stroke at constant width. It excels at refined display lines, whereas Noto Sans Vai does its best work in solid-block words with generous gaps where curves stop short of the stem.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-radio-canada: Close-set, flat and refined: that's Bevellier. Radio Canada's tall, full lowercase and open curve endings carry the eye smoothly down a whole column, since its line never swells or thins.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic brings a tight, contemporary sans partner to Expose. Both keep lowercase and capitals almost level in height, a shared trait that holds the pair together.
